messages.subject: My own likelihood model
parts:
Good morning

I have been searching in web page of Inla, papers, forums and other places. "how can I create my own likelihood models?", but I found only answers of how create my own prior distribution. i.e I need to fit a model, that not found in the list specified (http://www.r-inla.org/models/likelihoods). Someone know of a example for create your own likelihood model?

Thanks for your answers.
